description: RF Cascade Budget Analyzer. Runs server-side on rftools.io as an async job. Takes up to 12 .s2p file(s) via inputFiles (inline) or inputPaths (local paths); the server uploads them. Time budget 180 s. Returns a summarised result; ask for full for everything.

analysisFreq_hz.description: Analysis Freq (when using .s2p) (Hz). Frequency at which to sample |S21|² from uploaded Touchstone files. 0 = auto (mid-band of the file). omit for the default of 0

bandwidth_hz.description: Noise Bandwidth (Hz). e.g. 10e6 = 10 MHz IF bandwidth. min 1000, max 10000000000. omit for the default of 10000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

gainSpec_db.description: Gain Spec (min) (dB). min -30, max 100. Omit to let the service derive it: no spec (absent means not judged).

iip3Spec_dbm.description: IIP3 Spec (min) (dBm). min -40, max 50. Omit to let the service derive it: no spec (absent means not judged).

inputFiles.description: Optional. 0–12 file(s), .s2p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Inline content; at most 5 MB in one call. The server uploads them and passes the keys.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: Optional. 0–12 file(s), .s2p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Paths on this machine, read by the server and uploaded.

inputPower_dbm.description: Input Signal Power (dBm). min -130, max 20. omit for the default of -70

nfSpec_db.description: NF Spec (max) (dB). min 0, max 50. omit for the default of 6

snrMin_db.description: SFDR Min SNR (dB). SNR required at the detector, used as the SFDR reference floor. 0 = textbook SFDR referenced to the noise floor. Set e.g. 12 dB to reference SFDR to a usable-sensitivity floor instead. min 0, max 40. omit for the default of 0

stages.description: Stage Definitions (JSON). Array of stage objects. type: "amp"|"filter"|"attenuator"|"mixer"|"switch". Passive stages (filter/attenuator/switch) automatically set NF = |gain|.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_rf_cascade
title: RF Cascade Budget Analyzer
